title: First Valid Position
description: Given a sorted array that may contain repeated values, find the first zero-based index at which a target occurs. Return -1 if the target is absent.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; values are sorted in non-decreasing order; -10^9 <= values[i], target <= 10^9.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n sorted integers. Third line: target.
outputFormat: Print the first index containing the target, or -1.
hints: When the middle value equals the target, record it and continue searching toward the left.

examples.explanation: The first occurrence of 2 is at index 1.
4 does not occur in the array.
